```{=html}
<style>
  :root{
    --navy:#1E2A4A;
    --navy-light:#2B3A61;
    --coral:#E8734A;
    --coral-light:#F2A184;
    --coral-tint:#FFF3EE;
    --paper:#F7F7F5;
    --ink:#232A3B;
    --muted:#767F94;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{height:100%;}
  body{
    margin:0;
    font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
    background:#12182b;
    color:var(--ink);
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    min-height:100vh;
    padding:20px;
  }
  .deck{
    width:100%;
    max-width:980px;
    aspect-ratio:16/9;
    background:#fff;
    border-radius:14px;
    box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .deck-logo{
    position:absolute; top:16px; right:20px; z-index:5;
    background:#fff; padding:7px 14px; border-radius:9px;
    box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
    display:flex; align-items:center;
  }
  .deck-logo img{height:32px; display:block;}
  .slide{
    position:absolute;
    top:0; right:0; bottom:0; left:0;
    padding:34px 54px;
    display:none;
    flex-direction:column;
    justify-content:center;
    opacity:0;
    transform:translateX(24px);
    transition:opacity .3s ease, transform .3s ease;
    overflow:auto;
  }
  .slide::before{
    content:"";
    position:absolute; top:0; left:0; right:0; height:5px;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--coral) 0%, var(--coral-light) 100%);
  }
  .slide.title-slide::before{display:none;}
  .slide.active{display:flex; opacity:1; transform:translateX(0);}
  .kicker{
    font-size:12px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.13em; text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--coral); margin-bottom:7px;
  }
  h1{font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif; font-size:50.5px; font-weight:800; margin:0 0 12px; color:var(--navy); line-height:1.12; letter-spacing:-.01em;}
  h2{font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif; font-size:26.5px; font-weight:700; margin:0 0 11px; color:var(--navy);}
  h3{font-size:14.5px; margin:0 0 4px; color:var(--navy); font-weight:700;}
  p.lede{font-size:15.5px; color:var(--muted); margin:0 0 6px; line-height:1.5;}
  p.note{font-size:12.5px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:7px;}

  .title-slide{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy) 0%, var(--navy-light) 100%); color:#fff; position:relative;}
  .title-slide::after{
    content:""; position:absolute; right:-120px; top:-120px; width:420px; height:420px;
    border-radius:50%; background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(232,115,74,.16) 0%, rgba(232,115,74,0) 70%);
  }
  .title-slide h1{color:#fff; font-size:55px; font-weight:800;}
  .title-slide .accent{color:var(--coral-light);}
  .title-slide p.lede{color:#C7CCDA; font-size:18.5px;}
  .badge{margin-top:24px; font-size:17px; font-weight:700; color:#fff; letter-spacing:.01em;}
  .badge .sub{display:block; font-weight:400; font-size:14px; color:#9AA3BC; margin-top:2px;}
  .title-slide .deck-logo{background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);}

  .callout{border-radius:10px; padding:12px 16px; margin:9px 0;}
  .callout.navy{background:var(--navy); color:#fff;}
  .callout.navy .tag{color:var(--coral-light); font-weight:700; font-size:12px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; margin-bottom:5px;}
  .callout.navy p{margin:0; font-size:14.5px; line-height:1.5;}
  .callout.def{background:var(--paper); border-left:4px solid var(--navy); font-size:14.5px; line-height:1.5; color:var(--ink);}
  .callout.warn{background:var(--coral-tint); border-left:4px solid var(--coral); font-size:13px; line-height:1.5; color:var(--ink);}

  .bullets{list-style:none; margin:9px 0 0; padding:0;}
  .bullets li{font-size:15px; color:var(--ink); padding:5px 0 5px 22px; position:relative; line-height:1.4;}
  .bullets li::before{content:"•"; position:absolute; left:2px; color:var(--coral); font-size:18.5px; line-height:1;}

  .checklist{list-style:none; margin:8px 0 0; padding:0;}
  .checklist li{display:flex; align-items:flex-start; font-size:14px; margin-bottom:6px; color:var(--ink); line-height:1.4;}
  .checklist .num{flex-shrink:0; width:18px; height:18px; margin-right:9px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--navy); color:#fff; font-size:11px; font-weight:700; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;}
  .checklist .check{flex-shrink:0; width:18px; height:18px; margin-right:9px; border-radius:5px; border:2px solid var(--coral);}

  .stepslist{list-style:none; margin:6px 0 0; padding:0; counter-reset:step;}
  .stepslist li{counter-increment:step; display:flex; align-items:flex-start; font-size:12.5px; margin-bottom:5px; color:var(--ink); line-height:1.4;}
  .stepslist li::before{content:counter(step); flex-shrink:0; width:16px; height:16px; margin-right:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--coral); color:#fff; font-size:10.5px; font-weight:700; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;}

  .taskcard{background:var(--paper); border:1px solid #E2E2DE; border-left:4px solid var(--navy); border-radius:8px; padding:14px 17px; margin:9px 0;}
  .taskcard .ttag{font-size:11.5px; font-weight:800; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; color:var(--navy); margin-bottom:6px;}
  .taskcard .ttext{font-size:15.5px; line-height:1.6; color:var(--ink);}

  .codewrap{position:relative; margin:7px 0;}
  .codebox{background:#1c2440; color:#dfe6f5; border-radius:8px; padding:10px 54px 10px 13px; font-family:"SFMono-Regular",Consolas,"Liberation Mono",monospace; font-size:12.5px; line-height:1.6; overflow-x:auto;}
  .codebox .cm{color:#7d89ab;}
  .codecopybtn{position:absolute; top:7px; right:7px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.10); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22); color:#dfe6f5; border-radius:6px; padding:4px 9px; font-size:11.5px; cursor:pointer;}
  .codecopybtn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);}
  .codecopybtn.copied{background:var(--coral); border-color:var(--coral); color:#fff;}

  .datasetgrid{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; margin-top:8px;}
  .datasetcard{flex:1 1 40%; background:var(--paper); border:1px solid #E7E7E2; border-radius:10px; padding:12px 15px; box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.03);}
  .datasetcard .badge2{font-size:11px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.07em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--coral); margin-bottom:5px;}
  .datasetcard .file{font-family:"SFMono-Regular",Consolas,monospace; font-size:13px; color:var(--navy); margin-bottom:3px; font-weight:700;}
  .datasetcard .meta2{font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.5;}

  .cols2{display:flex; gap:14px;}
  .oscard{flex:1; background:var(--paper); border:1px solid #E7E7E2; border-radius:10px; padding:12px 15px;}

  .navbar{width:100%; max-width:980px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; margin-top:14px; color:#C7CCDA; font-size:14.5px;}
  .navbar .btns{display:flex; gap:8px;}
  .navbtn{background:#1c2440; border:1px solid #333d5c; color:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:7px 15px; font-size:14.5px; cursor:pointer;}
  .navbtn:hover{background:#2b3660;}
  .navbtn:disabled{opacity:.35; cursor:default;}
  .progress{font-size:13px; color:#8b93ad;}
</style>

<div class="deck" id="deck">

  <div class="deck-logo"><img src="eppslogo.png" alt="UTD EPPS logo"></div>

  <!-- 1: Title -->
  <div class="slide active title-slide">
    <div class="kicker">EPPS Math &amp; Coding Camp</div>
    <h1>R, RStudio &amp;<br><span class="accent">Data Structures</span></h1>
    <p class="lede">Vectors, factors, data frames, and lists.</p>
    <div class="badge">JP Adjadeh<span class="sub">EPPS, UT Dallas</span></div>
  </div>

  <!-- 2: QR Code check-in -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Before We Begin</div>
    <h2>Morning session check-in</h2>
    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:40px; margin-top:10px;">
      <img src="check_in_form.png" alt="Attendance check-in QR code" style="width:220px; height:220px; border-radius:10px; box-shadow:0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.08);">
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 3: Installing R -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Getting Set Up</div>
    <h2>Installing R</h2>
    <div class="cols2">
      <div class="oscard">
        <h3>Windows</h3>
        <ol class="stepslist">
          <li>Go to the R Project website (r-project.org)</li>
          <li>Select "Download R for Windows," then "base"</li>
          <li>Download and run the installer for the latest version</li>
        </ol>
      </div>
      <div class="oscard">
        <h3>macOS</h3>
        <ol class="stepslist">
          <li>Go to the R Project website (r-project.org)</li>
          <li>Select "Download R for macOS"</li>
          <li>Download the .pkg file for your macOS version and follow the prompts</li>
        </ol>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 4: Installing RStudio + quick check -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Getting Set Up</div>
    <h2>Installing RStudio</h2>
    <ol class="stepslist">
      <li>Go to the RStudio download page (posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop)</li>
      <li>Select "RStudio Desktop"</li>
      <li>Download the installer for your operating system</li>
    </ol>
    <div class="callout warn">Quick Check — open RStudio. In the console, type <code>version</code> and press Enter. That's the R version you're running today.</div>
  </div>

  <!-- 5: Package manager -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Getting Set Up</div>
    <h2>Installing a package manager</h2>
    <p class="lede"><code>pacman</code> simplifies installing and loading R packages. In the console, run:</p>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" id="c1">install.packages("pacman")<br>library(pacman)<br>p_load(readxl, ggplot2)</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy="install.packages(&quot;pacman&quot;)\nlibrary(pacman)\np_load(readxl, ggplot2)" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 6: Working directory - method 1 -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Getting Set Up</div>
    <h2>Setting the working directory</h2>
    <p class="lede">This tells R where to look for files by default.</p>
    <h3 style="margin-top:6px;">Method 1 — Point and click</h3>
    <ol class="stepslist">
      <li>In RStudio's menu: <b>Session &gt; Set Working Directory &gt; Choose Directory</b></li>
      <li>Navigate to a folder named <b>"Math and Coding Camp"</b> — create it first if it doesn't exist</li>
      <li>Place today's datasets inside that folder</li>
    </ol>
  </div>

  <!-- 7: Working directory - method 2 -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Getting Set Up</div>
    <h2>Method 2 — By code</h2>
    <p class="lede">Replace <code>paste path here</code> with your folder's actual location, keeping the quotation marks.</p>
    <div class="cols2">
      <div class="oscard">
        <h3>Windows</h3>
        <div class="codewrap">
          <div class="codebox" id="c2" style="font-size:12.5px;">setwd("paste path here")</div>
          <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='setwd("paste path here")' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
        </div>
        <p class="note">Right-click the folder → "Copy as path." Replace backslashes with forward slashes.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="oscard">
        <h3>macOS</h3>
        <div class="codewrap">
          <div class="codebox" id="c3" style="font-size:12.5px;">setwd("paste path here")</div>
          <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='setwd("paste path here")' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
        </div>
        <p class="note">Option + right-click the folder → "Copy '...' as Pathname."</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="callout warn">If R can't change the directory, the path is the problem — not the function.</div>
  </div>

  <!-- 8: Quick check working directory -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Getting Set Up</div>
    <h2>Quick check</h2>
    <div class="callout warn">Set your working directory using either method, then run <code>getwd()</code> to confirm it points to the right folder.</div>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" id="c4">getwd()</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy="getwd()" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 9: class() explained -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">The One Tool You'll Use Constantly</div>
    <h2><code>class()</code> — what does it do?</h2>
    <div class="callout def"><code>class()</code> tells you what type of object you're looking at — a number, text, true/false, a full table, or something else. It's the fastest way to answer: what am I actually working with?</div>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" id="c5">a &lt;- c(4, 8, 15, 16, 23)<br>b &lt;- c("red", "green", "blue")<br>d &lt;- TRUE<br>e &lt;- list(count = 5, label = "sample")<br><br>class(a)<br>class(b)<br>class(d)<br>class(e)</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='a <- c(4, 8, 15, 16, 23)\nb <- c("red", "green", "blue")\nd <- TRUE\ne <- list(count = 5, label = "sample")\n\nclass(a)\nclass(b)\nclass(d)\nclass(e)' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    <p class="note">Exercise 1 — before running each line, predict what it will return, then compare.</p>
  </div>

  <!-- 10: Dataset 1 import -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Dataset 1 of 3</div>
    <h2>Importing life_exp</h2>
    <div class="datasetgrid">
      <div class="datasetcard"><div class="badge2">life_exp</div><div class="file">US_Life_expectancy.csv</div><div class="meta2">239 rows · 4 columns</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="cols2">
      <div class="oscard">
        <h3>Point and click</h3>
        <p class="note" style="margin-top:0;">Environment pane → Import Dataset → From Text (base) → select the file → Import</p>
      </div>
      <div class="oscard">
        <h3>By code</h3>
        <div class="codewrap">
          <div class="codebox" id="c6" style="font-size:11.5px;">life_exp &lt;- read.csv("US_Life_expectancy.csv")<br>head(life_exp)</div>
          <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='life_exp <- read.csv("US_Life_expectancy.csv")\nhead(life_exp)' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="note">This is the only dataset we import for now — data 2 and 3 come later.</p>
  </div>

  <!-- 11: Concept - data frame & vector -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Before You Start</div>
    <h2>Two structures, defined</h2>
    <div class="callout def"><b>Data frame</b> — R's version of a spreadsheet: rows and columns, where each column is a vector.</div>
    <div class="callout def"><b>Vector</b> — a sequence of values of the same type: all numbers, or all text, but never mixed.</div>
  </div>

  <!-- 12: Task 1 D1 -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Dataset 1 — Task 1</div>
    <h2>What structure is life_exp?</h2>
    <div class="taskcard">
      <div class="ttag">Your Task</div>
      <div class="ttext">Determine the overall structure of life_exp, and the specific data type of its Average_Life_Expectancy column. Write your own AI prompt for this — role, task, context, format — then run it in RStudio.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 13: Guide 1 D1 -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Check Your Answer</div>
    <h2><code>str()</code> and <code>class()</code></h2>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" id="c7">str(life_exp)<br>class(life_exp)<br>class(life_exp$Average_Life_Expectancy)</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='str(life_exp)\nclass(life_exp)\nclass(life_exp$Average_Life_Expectancy)' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    <div class="callout def"><code>str()</code> stands for <b>structure</b> — it summarizes an object's type and shape in one call. Here it confirms life_exp is a data frame, and Average_Life_Expectancy is a numeric vector within it.</div>
  </div>

  <!-- 14: Task 2 D1 -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Dataset 1 — Task 2</div>
    <h2>Pull out a single column</h2>
    <div class="taskcard">
      <div class="ttag">Your Task</div>
      <div class="ttext">Extract the Gender column from life_exp on its own, confirm its class, and list its unique values. Write your own prompt for this.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 15: Guide 2 D1 -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Check Your Answer</div>
    <h2>A column, on its own</h2>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" id="c8">life_exp$Gender<br>class(life_exp$Gender)<br>unique(life_exp$Gender)</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='life_exp$Gender\nclass(life_exp$Gender)\nunique(life_exp$Gender)' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    <div class="callout def">A single column pulled out of a data frame is just a vector — R doesn't treat it any differently once it's on its own.</div>
  </div>

  <!-- 16: Task 3 D1 -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Dataset 1 — Task 3</div>
    <h2>Do something with the vector</h2>
    <div class="taskcard">
      <div class="ttag">Your Task</div>
      <div class="ttext">Compute the average and the range of the Average_Life_Expectancy vector. Write your own prompt for this.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 17: Guide 3 D1 -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Check Your Answer</div>
    <h2>Vectors support math directly</h2>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" id="c9">mean(life_exp$Average_Life_Expectancy, na.rm = TRUE)<br>range(life_exp$Average_Life_Expectancy, na.rm = TRUE)</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='mean(life_exp$Average_Life_Expectancy, na.rm = TRUE)\nrange(life_exp$Average_Life_Expectancy, na.rm = TRUE)' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    <div class="callout def">Vectors aren't just storage — R's math functions operate on them directly, element by element.</div>
  </div>

  <!-- 18: Dataset 2 import -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Dataset 2 of 3</div>
    <h2>Importing air</h2>
    <div class="datasetgrid">
      <div class="datasetcard"><div class="badge2">air</div><div class="file">Air_Quality.csv</div><div class="meta2">~14,000 rows · 9 columns — NYC public health data</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="cols2">
      <div class="oscard">
        <h3>Point and click</h3>
        <p class="note" style="margin-top:0;">Environment pane → Import Dataset → From Text (base) → select the file → Import</p>
      </div>
      <div class="oscard">
        <h3>By code</h3>
        <div class="codewrap">
          <div class="codebox" id="c10" style="font-size:11.5px;">air &lt;- read.csv("Air_Quality.csv")<br>head(air)</div>
          <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='air <- read.csv("Air_Quality.csv")\nhead(air)' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="note">life_exp is done for now — this dataset introduces the factor.</p>
  </div>

  <!-- 19: Concept - factor -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Before You Start</div>
    <h2>One more structure: the factor</h2>
    <div class="callout def">A <b>factor</b> is a vector with a fixed, known set of categories. It looks like text, but R treats it as belonging to a limited set of groups — which is what enables grouping, counting, and category-based charts.</div>
  </div>

  <!-- 20: Task 1 D2 -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Dataset 2 — Task 1</div>
    <h2>What's in each column?</h2>
    <div class="taskcard">
      <div class="ttag">Your Task</div>
      <div class="ttext">Determine which columns in air are numeric and which are text. Write your own prompt for this.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 21: Guide 1 D2 -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Check Your Answer</div>
    <h2>Same tool, bigger dataset</h2>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" id="c11">str(air)</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy="str(air)" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    <p class="note">Identify one text column whose values repeat frequently across rows — that's the one we'll use next.</p>
  </div>

  <!-- 22: Task 2 D2 -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Dataset 2 — Task 2</div>
    <h2>How many categories are there?</h2>
    <div class="taskcard">
      <div class="ttag">Your Task</div>
      <div class="ttext">For the repeating text column you identified, list its unique values and count how many there are. Write your own prompt for this.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 23: Guide 2 D2 -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Check Your Answer</div>
    <h2>Counting categories</h2>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" id="c12">unique(air$Name)<br>length(unique(air$Name))</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='unique(air$Name)\nlength(unique(air$Name))' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 24: Task 3 D2 -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Dataset 2 — Task 3</div>
    <h2>Make it official: convert to a factor</h2>
    <div class="taskcard">
      <div class="ttag">Your Task</div>
      <div class="ttext">Convert that column to a factor. Confirm its class before and after the conversion. Write your own prompt for this.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 25: Guide 3 D2 -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Check Your Answer</div>
    <h2>Before and after</h2>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" id="c13">class(air$Name)<br>air$Name &lt;- factor(air$Name)<br>class(air$Name)<br>levels(air$Name)</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='class(air$Name)\nair$Name <- factor(air$Name)\nclass(air$Name)\nlevels(air$Name)' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    <div class="callout def">A factor remains a vector; R additionally records that its values belong to a fixed set of categories.</div>

  <!-- 26: Dataset 3 import -->
  <div class="slide">

      <div class="datasetcard"><div class="badge2">ev</div><div class="file">Electric_Vehicle_Population_Data.xlsx</div><div class="meta2">~194,000 rows · 17 columns — our first Excel file</div></div>

    <h2>The most flexible structure: the list</h2>

      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='tesla_summary <- list(\n  count = nrow(tesla),\n  avg_range = mean(tesla$Electric_Range, na.rm = TRUE)\n)\nclass(tesla_summary)' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>

    <div class="callout def">A list holds elements of different types together without requiring a consistent row-and-column shape.</div>

  <!-- 32: Task 3 D3 -->

<div class="navbar">
  <div class="progress" id="progress">1 / 36</div>
  <div class="btns">
    <button class="navbtn" id="prevBtn" onclick="go(-1)">Prev</button>
    <button class="navbtn" id="nextBtn" onclick="go(1)">Next</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  const slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
  let current = 0;

  function render(){
    slides.forEach((s, i) => s.classList.toggle('active', i === current));
    document.getElementById('prevBtn').disabled = current === 0;
    document.getElementById('nextBtn').disabled = current === slides.length - 1;
    document.getElementById('progress').textContent = (current+1) + ' / ' + slides.length;
  }

  function go(delta){
    const next = current + delta;
    if(next >= 0 && next < slides.length){ current = next; render(); }
  }

  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if(e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'PageDown' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); go(1); }
    if(e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'PageUp') { e.preventDefault(); go(-1); }
  });

  function copyCode(btn){
    const raw = btn.getAttribute('data-copy').replace(/\\n/g, '\n');
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(raw).then(() => {
      const original = btn.textContent;
      btn.textContent = 'Copied!';
      btn.classList.add('copied');
      setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = original; btn.classList.remove('copied'); }, 1400);
    });
  }

  function sizeDeck(){
    const deck = document.getElementById('deck');
    deck.style.height = (deck.offsetWidth * 9 / 16) + 'px';
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', sizeDeck);
  sizeDeck();

  render();
</script>
```
